slides.1.title: Chinon × Rillettes and Level 2 Comprehensive Review
slides.1.content:
🍖 Chinon × Rillettes de Tours: A Perfect Loire Pairing

Rillettes de Tours (slow-cooked, potted shredded pork) is one of the Loire Valley's most iconic charcuterie products. Why does Chinon pair so perfectly?

  • Chinon's high natural acidity cuts through the richness of the fatty rillettes
  • Its fresh red-fruit character provides a bright contrast to the savory, earthy pork
  • The wine's light tannins don't clash with the delicate, slow-cooked texture
  • Both are products of the same terroir — the classic "what grows together goes together" principle
